text:
Avery: Quick giveaway - Im clearing out my desk stuff before a move. Up for grabs: a purple anti-fatigue standing mat (lightly used) and 2x Craft Beer Fest tokens for Sat afternoon. Pick up from SOMA office before 6pm. Pics: https://imgur.com/matbeer

Camille: Ooh Id love the mat if its still available. Measurements?

Avery: Mat is ~120cm x 45cm, rolls up fine. No stains, just some indent from my chair. Tokens are for the 1-4pm tasting slot.

Tobias: Id take the tokens if Camille wants the mat. I work Sat but could use the afternoon. Can pick up Friday after 5:30.

FacilitiesBot: Reminder: pickups after 6pm need facilities escort. Book via the portal.

Camille: Friday 5pm works for me for the mat. Happy to help carry if someone else needs both items moved. DMing you now Avery.

Jon: If Camille passes on the tokens, Im down. Also, please use the freight elevator for anything bulky.

Avery: Thanks all. Ill put the mat in locker D and label it "For Camille". Tokens I'll leave at front desk in an envelope marked "Tobias" unless Tobias wants me to hold until Friday.

Tobias: Envelope at front desk is perfect. Ill grab them Friday. Thanks Avery!

Camille: Claimed the mat. Bringing a tote to carry it home. Thanks Avery! :sparkles:

Avery: Sweet — glad its going to you. If anything changes Ill update here. Enjoy the fest, Tobias! :beers:

(Reaction: Camille reacted with :raised_hands: to the first message)
